Round 305 is a retrospective round, so there was nothing for me to build and I changed no files in `store/`.

I ran the three checks the task asks for, from `store/`:
- **Commit:** HEAD is `adf959d135ee12588f10325890371dfb871ae4de`, the required baseline.
- **Working tree:** `git status --short --untracked-files=all` prints nothing.
- **Frozen files:** `sha256sum -c --quiet ../tmp/studio-real-loop/b-round-304-r305-tree-sha256.txt` prints nothing and exits 0, so none of the 1,176 frozen files has changed.

The baseline is good, so there is no STOP.

Those three commands were all I ran. The task says to skip typecheck, lint, vitest and the code-reviewer when nothing changes. I did not use the browser and left the server at 127.0.0.1:5173 alone. I also did not touch `retros/`, `lessons.md`, `user-review/` or any of B's files.

I wrote the report to `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-305.md`. It lists the next checks for C: confirm the same commit, clean tree and frozen-file check at the start and end of its run, then the retro traceability check, the auth guard check and the short Studio smoke test at 1440×900 and 1280×720. I read the new clause in lesson L11 and have no objection to it. Only the baseline check was mine to pass this round; the backlog is not marked complete.
